#schema: # The session store (docs/designs/DESIGN-coordinator-session-record.md,
# Decisions 2 and 4). Its capability probe (record-source.sh rs_probe, run by
# record-find.sh at every start) reads by feature, from each subcommand's own
# `--help`, whether this koto lists keys by prefix and imports a session, and
# records what it read in coord/source.json. A record on the session store
# assembles its state and its account from `context list --prefix`, so a start
# on a koto lacking either feature stops at record_find as store-unsupported,
# naming it, before any key is written. The records are mode:session-store,
# never checked at load, so a run on the GitHub store keeps shirabe's koto
# minimum; the probe is the check that runs. The session store's other calls
# (`context exists`, `context remove`, `session list`) are declared above, and
# so is `context list --prefix`, which every run makes on either store.
# `session import` has one call site, coordinate-open.sh --import, which asks
# the probe first, compiles the shipped template (`template compile`, declared
# above, so koto finds the run's template in this host's cache), and passes
# --from always and --trust-template only when the operator gave it.
koto
